# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ndina uira, Wee Ngai wakwa, ati Wee wanyumbire nigetha ngumenye na ngukumagie. Na ndina uira thiini wa kahiinda gaaka iguru ria wagi uhoti wakwa na iguru ria uhoti waku, iguru ria uthiini wakwa na iguru ria utonga waku. Gutiri Ngai ungi tiga Wee, Uria Muteithia wa Ugwaati-ini, Uria Wirugaimie.
